reactions.name: Rampart
actor_effects: one eruption hit raises a breakable pillar that cuts a firing lane or creates a wallrun approach
counters: break the 32-Health pillar, go around, or wait; trapped occupants can escape

reactions.name: Magma
counters: leave or jump before the next pulse

reactions.name: Quagmire
actor_effects: 70% ground acceleration and braking; staying for 350 ms starts grounded attrition
counters: jump or leave before 350 ms; movement ratios end immediately outside

reactions.name: Sandblast
actor_effects: one grounded hit and 14 px sideways displacement per hostile actor
counters: jump across or leave during formation; solid cover stops the displacement

reactions.name: Crystal Prism
actor_effects: one hostile contact cut; bank existing paid projectiles off a breakable reflection plane
counters: change approach or break the 18-Health plane with Spray; ownership never changes

reactions.name: Blightsoil
actor_effects: grounded pulses deny Health, Flux and Stamina recovery while occupied
counters: jump or leave the soil; ordinary recovery waits still apply afterwards

reactions.name: Steam
counters: exit or cool with a fresh Water cast

reactions.name: Arcstorm
actor_effects: one warned electrical line burst; one separate paid Fire source can extend the arc
counters: leave the previewed line before activation or consume its optional Fire link

reactions.name: Solar Flare
actor_effects: one radial flash deals damage and reveals targets for 700 ms
counters: leave the forming disk; this pulse cannot fire again

reactions.name: Backdraft
actor_effects: concealing fuse becomes transparent for its last 600 ms, then bursts once
counters: leave during the visible final warning; no damage before detonation

reactions.name: Frostway
actor_effects: one grounded freezing hit; ground travel is 75% and physical projectiles travel at 65%
counters: slide, jump, or leave; air movement and slide speed remain unchanged

reactions.name: Hailcurrent
actor_effects: narrow hail pulses combine with a grounded current along the cast direction
counters: leave laterally; jumping avoids current and ground-level hail

reactions.name: Mirrorwater
actor_effects: disturbing the mirror surface reveals movement and triggers damage on each pulse
counters: stand still between pulses after the entry reveal, or leave the disk

reactions.name: Black Ice
actor_effects: entry briefly slows; the first grounded exit fractures the ice for one hit
counters: jump out to avoid the exit fracture; each actor can be hit only once

reactions.name: Vortex
actor_effects: rotating ground current and pulses guard an annulus around an open center
counters: use the center opening, jump, or leave between pulses

reactions.name: Lightbend
actor_effects: one hostile contact flash; bend paid Light projectiles by 15 degrees for a different attack angle
counters: change the Light approach angle or leave the redirected firing lane

reactions.name: Shadowdraft
actor_effects: a stationary corridor alternates 300 ms of concealing damage and 300 ms of clear safety
counters: cross during the transparent interval or leave laterally

reactions.name: Radiance
actor_effects: continuous reveal and regular searing pulses also threaten airborne actors
counters: leave between 600 ms pulses; jumping alone does not escape

reactions.name: Penumbra
actor_effects: one damaging revealed boundary crossing per actor, with a safe interior
counters: avoid the marked ring or shelter inside; repeated crossings cannot repeat the hit

reactions.name: Umbral Field
actor_effects: concealed dwell pressure grows from 2 to 6 Health per pulse after one second
counters: move to reveal occupants or exit before one second; exit resets dwell pressure
